==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Time resumes and the snow clears. Mt. Firmament emerges from its long seclusion, ready to embrace its revival.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_407_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_407_1_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' One suggests heading back to Hongzhen to reunite with your companions, {{MC|m=Lord|f=Lady}} Arbiter.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_407_2.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' With Mt. Firmament no longer posing a threat, surely Hongzhen will undergo significant changes.
----
;(When player returns to Hongzhen)
:[[File:Seq mtfrmmq m1_8_18 p1.png|500px]]
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_1.ogg}} '''Storyteller:''' Mt. Firmament glowed with the sun's light, high above the clouds and snow. Then suddenly, they vanished, revealing a distant blue sky.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_2.ogg}} '''Storyteller:''' And amidst it all stood a white-haired maiden, like a goddess descended from the heavens.

:[[File:Seq mtfrmmq m1_8_18 p2.png|500px]]
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_3.ogg}} '''Storyteller:''' With a mere wave of her hand, she brought forth a new season, transforming the streets below.

:[[File:Seq mtfrmmq m1_8_18 p3.png|500px]]
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_4.ogg}} '''Storyteller:''' This maiden was none other than the dead infant, now reborn as the Magistrate of Jinzhou.

:[[File:Seq mtfrmmq m1_8_18 p4_M.png|250px]] [[File:Seq mtfrmmq m1_8_18 p4_F.png|250px]]
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_5.ogg}} '''Storyteller:''' "When thunder roars in spring's embrace, the sun shall shine upon this place."
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_6.ogg}} '''Storyteller:''' "For only through death and strife, can one truly embrace new life."
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_7.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Hmm... I see. Doesn't matter. That's not important for our goal.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_8.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' We have the answers we wanted already.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_9.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' —With the Second Resonance Awakening, we will tap into powers that rival the Sentinels... Complete control of the artificial Resonator Awakening process is within reach.       
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_11.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' And lastly, about that Rover...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_12.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' This trip was worth it. We've collected many wonderful notes, haven't we?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_13.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' It's about time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_410_14.ogg}} '''Phrolova:''' Get moving. Can't let [[Scar|a certain someone]] wait too long behind bars.
;Huanglong I - Act VII '''Thaw of Eons''' [Quest Complete]
{{Dialogue End}}
